title: Wells Fargo supports local nonprofits
description: The Wells Fargo Community Relations team and executives delivered 10 $25,000 checks to local nonprofits on Giving Tuesday on Tuesday, Nov. 27, 2018. Photo by Johanna Huckeba, [EMAIL].

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Wells Fargo charitable outreach event where donations are delivered to local nonprofits. The speaker discusses community financial literacy and philanthropy, while the frames show presentation checks rather than requests for audience payment, credentials, or investment participation. The St. Louis Post-Dispatch title card and reported nonprofit event are consistent with community-news coverage.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is a community charitable event, presented through a report of donations to nonprofits and footage of check presentations.
